jobs.description: 1 Converter Service Specialist - Technical Sales & Field Service (f/m/*) WHAT ARE MY RESPONSIBILITIES?As a Converter Service Specialist (Technical Sales & Field Service) in our department Metallurgical Services (MS AT TI), you will be part of our growing Converter Services team - expanding Primetals Technologies' footprint in the global steelmaking market. You will act as both a technical expert and sales engineer: understanding customer needs, presenting our service solutions, and performing converter inspections, audits, and modernization activities on site. Your goal: turn technical know-how into customer value - by combining strong engineering expertise, hands-on field work, and proactive sales engagement.Tasks and Responsibilities * Serve as the primary technical and technical-sales contact for converterrelated services (inspection, modernization, process audits, lifecycle management) * Conduct independent customer visits worldwide, presenting Primetals Technologies solutions and identifying new business opportunities * Perform on-site services, including mechanical inspections, condition assessments, and converter fitness checks * Prepare and coordinate technical offers for spare parts, inspections, and modernization projects * Analyze inspection results and prepare professional technical reports * Translate customer requirements into technical solutions and service concepts * Support modernization and upgrade planning, including spare parts and maintenance strategies * Cooperate closely with internal departments (engineering, sales, purchasing) * Execute supplier inspections and provide technical supervision during installation and commissioning * Prepare and deliver presentations and training sessions for internal teams and customers * Contribute to knowledge sharing and development within the converter services networkWHAT DO I NEED TO QUALIFY FOR THIS JOB? * Completed higher technical education (HTL/FH/University) in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, or related field * Several years of practical experience in converter operation, maintenance, or mechanical design - ideally from a steel plant environment * Proven hands-on experience and readiness to perform on-site work (inspection, measurement, supervision, commissioning) * Strong interest or proven experience in technical sales and customer relations * Good understanding of mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems * Basic knowledge of converter process and metallurgical principles advantageous * Knowledge of AutoCAD, NX (Unigraphics), technical drawings * Confident use of MS Office * Very good English skills, written and spoken * High willingness to travel internationally (approx. 20-30%) * Proactive, communicative, and solution-oriented personalityOn a personal level you convince us with your analytical mindset, strong commercial awareness, and effective negotiation skills, complemented by a hands-on mentality. You work independently, take ownership of your responsibilities, and represent Primetals Technologies with professionalism and confidence at customer sites.WHAT ELSE DO I NEED TO KNOW?The minimum annual gross salary for this position under the collective agreement and assuming that all requirements are met is EUR 47.546,94 (E/00). This could rise considerably, depending on qualifications and experience. Our Pioneers at Heart receive ongoing training in a wide range of areas through the "Metals Academy". In addition, we offer further benefits: From flexible working hours and home office options to free parking and discounted lunch menus. We also offer a voluntary sixth week of holiday from the age of 50.HOW DO I APPLY?If you are interested in this challenging and exciting position within an international environment, then submit your application online now:https://jobs.primetals.com/Job/263371. In the Global Products Group, we are dedicated to excellence in the design and engineering of Lam's panel products. We drive innovation to ensure our cutting-edge solutions are helping to solve the biggest challenges in the semiconductor / advanced packaging industry. 1 Key Account Technology Manager (all genders) Job-ID: 203508 I Work Location Model: On-site I Arbeitsort: Salzburg I Work Country: Österreich

The impact you'll make

The Manager of Key Account Technology (KAT) will play a pivotal role in managing and nurturing relationships with our key customers while developing and growing the team. As Manager of KAT, you will be required to attend customer technical review meetings to represent the Panel Product Line. Additionally, you will be responsible for developing the Key Account Technologists within the team. This position requires a deep understanding of advanced packaging and semiconductor processes and equipment, as well as the ability to provide technical expertise and support to ensure customer satisfaction and success. It also requires strong leadership skills.

What you'll do

 * Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with sales, engineering, and product development teams to align customer needs with company objectives

Who we're looking for

We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months and now serve 10,000+ customers.

Fonio is Europe's market leader for AI phone agents for SMBs. Now we're expanding globally and into new products.

We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings.

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Forward Deployment Engineer - Spanish (m/f/d) Your Role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer for our Spanish market, you work directly at the intersection of product and customer setups. You capture requirements, translate them into robust implementations, and take fonio live at customers - including integrations, automations, and ongoing optimization.

You work closely with Product/Engineering and Go-to-Market, making sure deployments are fast, stable, and repeatable across the Spanish market.

What you'll do

º Capture customer requirements and translate them into concrete implementation plans

º Build and roll out fonio setups in production: workflows, logic, prompts, guardrails

º Implement integrations with third-party systems (APIs, webhooks, CRM, calendar, ticketing, etc.)

º Develop smaller features and glue code to cleanly map customer cases

º Debug under production conditions: calls, flows, edge cases, fast fixes

º Build reusable templates and deployment playbooks to make setups scalable

º Deliver product feedback: bring pain points and feature gaps to the team, prioritized and concrete

Who we're looking for

º Solid coding skills: you can implement independently, not just configure

º Strong understanding of AI systems and LLMs (prompting, tool-use, RAG, failure modes)

º Workflow thinking: translate complex processes into robust, testable flows

º Experience with APIs, webhooks, auth, and common integration patterns

º Cloud fundamentals: deployments, observability, debugging in production

º Highly pragmatic working style: ship fast, make it stable, iterate

º Bonus: Voice/Telephony, n8n, TypeScript/Python, SQL, monitoring/tracing, GDPR

º Spanish at native or near-native level + solid English

What we offer

º Competitive salary: €60,000-€95,000 per year

º 100% Focus Time (no regular meetings)

º Unlimited budget when the ROI is right

º Extreme speed (we ship almost daily)

º Thousands of enthusiastic customers building the product together with us

Hiring Process

 * 25 min intro

 * 30 min deep dive with CTO & Co-Founder Matthias

 * 20 min culture fit with one of our founders

How we hire?

We're AI-native, including in hiring. AI helps us to remain efficient, but people make every decision.

fonio is an equal opportunity employer. We hire for talent and ownership, whatever your background is.

Need an adjustment in the process? Just tell us.

Please send your CV in English. Then knock us off our feet ¿

Not "support sales". You dial, you book, you own the number.The upside for you: cold calling is a skill you can only learn by volume. Doing it +200 times a week for six months will teach you more about business than any course you could sign up for.Your RoleWeek 1 to 4: Get on the phone * Shadow the founders on live calls, then take over your own call blocks * Learn the pitch, the finance language and the three objections that come up every single time * 60 to 80 dials per call block, roughly 200 per week * Book your first qualified meetingMonth 2 to 3: Own your pipeline * Build and clean your own target lists (Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Clay) * Research accounts before you dial, so the opener actually lands (or automate it) * Handle the full top of funnel: dial, qualify, book, hand over * Keep the CRM clean enough that we can actually read itMonth 4 and beyond: Build the machine * Test openers, lists and follow-up sequences, and tell us what works * Turn what works into a playbook the next hire can use * Grow into full-cycle sales, sit in on discovery and demo calls, take your own dealsWhat You Need to BringNon-negotiables: * German really well, solid English. Austrian and German CFOs will not do a discovery call in English. * You are not scared of the phone. Ten rejections in a row annoy you, they don't break you. * We don't care what you studied, or whether you studied at all. University, gap year, or straight out of HAK all work. How you talk matters more than what's on your certificate. * 20 h/week, on site in Vienna. Cold calling is a team sport and you learn it fastest sitting next to someone who's already good at it. * High agency. You see what needs to happen and make it happen.Strong plus: * Any job where you've had to talk to strangers and sell something: promotion, fundraising, retail, call center, student org * Finance or accounting background, or genuine curiosity about how a controlling team actually works * You've used Apollo, HubSpot, Attio, lemlist or similar before * You use the latest AI tools to automate annoying manual work and follow-upsWhat You'll GetCompensation: * 20 h/week to start. If it works for both sides, more hours or a full-time contract are possible later. * You earn the same whether the week went well or badly.
